Only 5 of the 47 WorldSmall ports have an observation; every other rotation is priced at the reference (basis 'global_reference').
fuel_pricing.licence_note: Read from public Ship & Bunker price pages (full markets and downloads require login/subscription; no reuse licence is stated on the pages; https://shipandbunker.com/terms was not reviewed).
